text:
joni: I'm updating the quickstart to include a minimal hello app + local container run. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4444. Posting here for quick checks.

mark: Nice. Two quick asks: keep both Node + Python snippets and add a one-liner to run locally with docker.

joni: Draft Docker run example in the PR: `docker run -e REDWOOD_API_KEY=$REDWOOD_API_KEY -p 8080:8080 quickstart-hello` plus a tiny health endpoint example.

nina: CI flagged docs build: missing `mkdocs-material`. build-bot: see logs.

build-bot: check status  PR #4444  failing: docs/build  logs: https://ci.redwood-inference/internal/4444/logs

mark: Also avoid showing a hardcoded key in Dockerfile. Instead show `ENV REDWOOD_API_KEY="" # set locally or via secrets` and a short note: "Do not commit secrets."

joni: Will update: add ENV note, healthcheck, and split examples into `/examples/quickstart/node` and `/examples/quickstart/python`. Will also pin `@redwood/sdk@^5.2.0` in the Node snippet.

nina: If you want I can open a tiny follow-up PR to add mkdocs-material to docs/requirements.txt.

joni: Please do, thanks. Plan: push Dockerfile tweaks and mkdocs fix tonight, wait for green CI, then request final copy-edit.
